key: Clue scroll (beginner) - Buried beneath the ground
hint: Buried beneath the ground, who knows where it's found. Lucky for you, A man called Reldo may have a clue.

fields.text: Buried beneath the ground, who knows where it's found. Lucky for you, A man called Reldo may have a clue.
fields.items: [[Spade]], [[strange device]].
fields.notes:
Speak to [[Reldo]] to receive a [[strange device]] used by [[Hot and cold clues]] to locate the location of the next clue.

Players can immediately start the search without speaking to [[Reldo]] if they already own a [[strange device]].

To find your location, click on the strange device and it will tell you how close you are to the treasure. Its temperature is based on the distance of the treasure from the player, measured in the number of steps it would take to reach the treasure, ignoring any obstacles. Then, teleport or walk to another location, and check to see if the strange device has gotten warmer. Repeat to pinpoint a location. You can also use [[Treasure_Trails/Guide/Hot_Cold#Beginner_Hot_Cold_clue_locations|this list of solutions]] to help you find your location. For each location, there is a 7x7 square in which you can dig to find the treasure.

[[Cheer]] in the Entrana Church. Players must take a [[needle]], [[thread]], and six [[Black_dragon_leather|black dragon leathers]], and craft the armour after arriving at [[Entrana]] requiring level 84 [[Crafting]] (boostable). Since players can't take in weapons, if the player does not wish to fight the Double Agent unarmed, options include bringing runes for offensive spells, materials to fletch ranged equipment, or [[celastrus bark]] to fletch a battlestaff.

''Should players disconnect or log out while carrying the crafted armour on Entrana, they will be knocked out by a [[monk]] and sent to [[Port Sarim]] when logging back in. If this happens, the leather will need to be reobtained when attempting this clue again.''

fields.text:

Lucky for you, a man called Watson may have a clue.
fields.notes:
Speak to [[Watson]] to receive a [[strange device]] used by [[Hot and cold clues]] to locate the location of the next clue.

Players can immediately start the search without speaking to [[Watson]] if they already own a [[strange device]].

To find your location, click on the strange device and it will tell you how close you are to the treasure. Its temperature is based on the distance of the treasure from the player, measured in the number of steps it would take to reach the treasure, ignoring any obstacles. Then, teleport or walk to another location, and check to see if the strange device has gotten warmer. Repeat to pinpoint a location. You can also use [[Treasure_Trails/Guide/Hot_Cold#Master_Hot_Cold_clue_locations|this list of solutions]] to help you find your location. For each location, there is a 7x7 square in which you can dig to find the treasure.
